svg.text: Controller U1: Arduino Uno pin assignment
Every Uno pin with its net. Matches firmware/ResQBot_Uno/config.h.
Controller U1: Arduino Uno pin assignment
Drawn: ResQBot team · Date: 2026-10-18 · Resistors ¼ W 5 %
• Everything is 5 V logic: HC-SR04, PIR, MQ-2, DHT11 and MLX90614 connect directly. Only D1 → ESP32-CAM is divided.
• Servo library uses Timer1 (no PWM on D9/D10): those pins only carry IN3/IN4 direction signals. Speed PWM is on D5/D6.
• D0/D1 are shared with USB: unplug the D0 wire while uploading.
